summary: This manuscript presents PAULI-ACO-BQAC0-CERT-1.0, a fully machine-checked, zero-float verification and certificate suite formalizing the Pauli-spectrum, Boolean Fourier, twirling-contraction, and stretched-exponential inequalities underlying constant-depth quantum advice lower bounds. Building on Sun and Wang's breakthrough proof of AC0 not-subset BQAC0/qpoly, the author constructs 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems and 16 exact-Q SHA-256-indexed rational certificates validated by 62 adversarial tests. The work rigorously certifies exact Pauli weight subspace compression at sublinear cutoffs, symplectic Z-group twirling projections, exact Fourier spectra and variance tails for P-uniform monotone depth-2 CNFs, zero-float Taylor-certified stretched-exponential decay bounds for state 2-designs and NLTS Hamiltonians, and operator-norm advantage transfer rules. The formalization is exceptionally rigorous, depending solely on standard foundational axioms with zero sorry or Classical.choice.
strengths: Flawless machine-checked formalization in Lean 4.36.0 with zero axioms, zero sorry, and zero Classical.choice.
Comprehensive exact-Q rational certificate suite (C01-C16) backed by 62 adversarial pytest tests with zero floating-point arithmetic.
Rigorous combination of sublinear Pauli subspace compression, symplectic Z-twirling projections, and exact Boolean Fourier spectra for monotone CNFs.
Exemplary clarity, documentation, and structural layout featuring comprehensive summary tables and informative figures.
weaknesses: Relies on imported circuit-level product-projection localization theorems from Sun and Wang [7] rather than re-proving them within Lean, though this separation of concerns is clearly delineated.
strong_novelty_candidates: Machine-checked exact-rational certification of sublinear-degree Pauli subspace compression and symplectic Z-twirling contractions.
Zero-float Taylor-certified stretched-exponential decay bounds for state 2-designs and low-energy NLTS Hamiltonian spectra.
